text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are on the way back
to campus
after going out. Suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On Rice Shower's outstretched finger
rests a very
small ladybug.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ladybugs are a sign of good luck. Did
you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time one's ever landed on
me...
Maybe something good is going to
happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A bit later, Rice Shower stops at a
vending
machine to buy juice, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower blinks in surprise as the
word
“Winner” flickers vibrantly on the
vending
machine's display.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I've never won anything from a
vending
machine before in my life.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower hangs her head as if she's
uneasy for
some reason.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm a little scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I have good luck now... that probably
means...
I'm going to bring bad luck to
everyone else
later...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because... that's what always happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I think... what worries me the most...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is the fact that I always end up having
these
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something good happened
to me...
and I'm here with you... I still
think this way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something good happened
to me...
and I'm here with you... I still
think this way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. That is my goal, after all.
choice_data_list: 不幸にした以上にライスが幸せにすればいい
それも思い出にしよう

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I can't help but wonder... can I really
do it? Is
it pointless to even try?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...
choice_data_list: 俺にそれを手伝わせて
私にそれを手伝わせて

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it on my own,
but
maybe I can do it with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it on my own,
but
maybe I can do it with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Or at least, I will someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Rice Shower's feeling more

optimistic, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Turn misfortune... into memories?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never thought of it that way before.
Can you
really do that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...
choice_data_list: 俺はそれをライスとの思い出にするよ
私はそれをライスとの思い出にするよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're with me, I'll try to do
the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're with me, I'll try to do
the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No... I will do the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's expression lightens a
little.
